Descriptive: 975 of 2,786 accessible repositories have root guidance; AGENTS.md 666 files, CLAUDE.md 615, GEMINI.md 25; families Generic 683 (51.5%), Claude 615 (46.4%), Gemini 25 (1.9%), Other 2 (0.2%); 645 repos with one root file, 312 two, 16 three, 2 four; generic-only 353 (36.2%), mixed 327 (33.5%), tool-specific-only 295 (30.3%); 143 of 331 multi-file repos (43.2%) have a root-root pair >=0.85 similarity; 118 exact AGENTS.md-CLAUDE.md duplicate pairs; 161 symlinked guidance files. Testing themes (of 300): commands 249 (83.0%), locations 186 (62.0%), strategy 156 (52.0%), mentality 144 (48.0%), framework/environment 142 (47.3%), tips 109 (36.3%), types 74 (24.7%), coverage 71 (23.7%), avoidance 57 (19.0%), mocking 52 (17.3%), examples 39 (13.0%), naming/style 38 (12.7%); median 4 themes per repository

Subjectivity of manual coding (single main coder, 10% double-coded); keyword detection may miss testing guidance, RQ2 only covers repos with testing keywords; filename allowlist excludes other files/non-Markdown/tool settings; one-hop referred-file boundary; path-based scope and similarity thresholds are approximations; only popular repos with agentic PRs; Markdown-only; conventions evolving rapidly. Future: whether explicit testing guidance changes agent behaviour (over-mocking, alignment with test patterns, superficial coverage); compare agent-facing vs human-facing docs; longitudinal studies
